fields.name: romName
fields.notes: ROM display-name metadata written into the settings string; not itself a randomization toggle. Included for completeness/full API parity.

fields.name: currentRestrictions
fields.notes: Takes a GenRestrictions object (see top-level 'genRestrictions' section). Only meaningful when limitPokemon is true.

fields.name: currentMiscTweaks
fields.notes: Takes an int bitmask. See top-level 'miscTweaks' section for each individual tweak's bit value; the shim should OR together the bitValue of every checked tweak and pass the result as this int.

fields.name: updateMoves
fields.notes: Update move data (power/accuracy/PP/etc) to match a later generation's values, up to updateMovesToGeneration.

fields.name: updateMovesLegacy
fields.notes: Legacy/older variant of the move-data-update feature, kept for backward compatibility with old settings strings.

fields.name: updateMovesToGeneration
fields.notes: Generation number (e.g. 1-7) to update move data to; only relevant when updateMoves is true.

fields.name: evosAllowAltFormes
fields.notes: Declared alongside the other Evolutions-tab fields in Settings.java, but its setter is interleaved with the General Options setter cluster (between removeTimeBasedEvolutions and raceMode) and packed into the same 'evolutions' byte (byte 26) as evosSimilarStrength etc. Grouped here as General Options based on setter ordering; could plausibly belong under Evolutions instead - verify against the live GUI if exact tab placement matters.

fields.name: blockBrokenMoves
fields.notes: Convenience setter: internally sets blockBrokenMovesetMoves, blockBrokenTMMoves, and blockBrokenTutorMoves all to the same value in one call. Those three fields also have their own independent setters (in Movesets, TMs, and Move Tutors groups respectively).

fields.name: limitPokemon
fields.notes: Enables the generation-restriction pool defined by currentRestrictions (GenRestrictions).

fields.name: baseStatisticsMod
fields.notes: Java setter signature is `setBaseStatisticsMod(boolean... bools)`. Internally it calls Settings.getEnum(BaseStatisticsMod.class, bools), which requires exactly one `true` in the array (IllegalStateException otherwise) and maps it to BaseStatisticsMod.values()[index_of_true]. The boolean array must be sized to BaseStatisticsMod.values().length, with `true` at the position matching the selected enum constant's ordinal (declaration order, as listed in the top-level "enums" map) and `false` everywhere else. The shim should treat this as a single-select dropdown/radio driven by the enum, then translate the chosen enum name to the one-hot boolean array by ordinal before calling the setter via reflection.

fields.name: updateBaseStatsToGeneration

genRestrictions.notes: Plain bag of public boolean fields (no getters/setters - accessed directly as public fields in Java). Settings.setCurrentRestrictions(GenRestrictions) takes a whole instance of this object. The int-constructor bit layout (GenRestrictions(int state)) is: bit0=allow_gen1, bit1=allow_gen2, bit2=allow_gen3, bit3=allow_gen4, bit4=allow_gen5, bit5=allow_gen6, bit6=allow_gen7, bit7=allow_evolutionary_relatives.

fields.name: allow_gen1
fields.notes: Allow Pokemon from Generation 1 (Red/Blue/Yellow) in the randomization pool.

fields.name: allow_gen2
fields.notes: Allow Pokemon from Generation 2 (Gold/Silver/Crystal).

fields.name: allow_gen3
fields.notes: Allow Pokemon from Generation 3 (Ruby/Sapphire/Emerald/FR/LG).

fields.name: allow_gen4
fields.notes: Allow Pokemon from Generation 4 (Diamond/Pearl/Platinum/HG/SS).

fields.name: allow_gen5
fields.notes: Allow Pokemon from Generation 5 (Black/White/B2/W2).

fields.name: allow_gen6
fields.notes: Allow Pokemon from Generation 6 (X/Y/OR/AS).

fields.name: allow_gen7
fields.notes: Allow Pokemon from Generation 7 (Sun/Moon/Ultra Sun/Ultra Moon).

fields.name: allow_evolutionary_relatives
fields.notes: Also allow Pokemon that are evolutionary relatives (pre-evolutions/evolutions) of an allowed-generation Pokemon, even if that relative's own generation is not checked.
